name: Elias Mangus
source:
Prince of the kingdom of Wedel.
He's currently a first year university student.
He's not very good at studying and would rather move his body, his hobby is American Football.
He has great trust in his butler Ian and he's acquaintances with Tokumaru and Said, but he worships his cousin Ashe.
